mentions.name: TypeQuicker
mentions.description: An intelligent typing application that helps users reach 100+ wpm by identifying and focusing practice on their weak points, with just 5-10 minutes of practice a day over a few months.
mentions.problem: Typing speed improvement stalls when practice isn't targeted at individual weak points.
mentions.audience: Anyone looking to increase their typing speed to 100+ wpm
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building an intelligent typing application. https://typequicker.com

Anyone can learn to type +100wpm - just have to focus on your weak points and spend 5-10 minutes a day for a few months.

mentions.name: TypeQuicker
mentions.description: This is a modern typing application that trains people to type quickly without thinking about or looking down at the keyboard. It aims to make fast typing attainable for anyone, with an emphasis on serving knowledge workers for whom typing is a key skill.
mentions.problem: Typing is one of the most important 21st-century skills for knowledge workers, yet it is one of the most neglected, and existing tools don't get people to fast, touch-typed proficiency quickly.
mentions.audience: Knowledge workers, plus anyone who wants to learn to type fast without looking down at the keyboard
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a modern typing application.

https://typequicker.com

I believe typing is probably one of the most important skills in 21st century for knowledge workers and yet one of the most neglected. Hoping to change that.

Anyone can learn to type fast, without having to think about or look down at the keyboard. We are building the best tool to help people get there quickly
